concerns.text: The specification replaces the paired t‑test (explicitly required in the idea) with McNemar’s test. This changes the statistical methodology and therefore the research question, constituting a methodological drift.
Power analysis is performed for a paired t‑test (Cohen’s d) while the actual analysis uses McNemar’s test, making the a‑priori power claim invalid.
Sensitivity analysis (US‑4 / FR‑006) was not part of the original idea and adds work beyond the stated scope.
The TinyLlama decoder‑only baseline is introduced in the spec but was never mentioned in the idea; this is an unrequested baseline.

The core research question asks whether the hint signal captures reasoning *independent* of the visual policy’s representation learning, yet the spec does not include an explicit experiment isolating that factor; it only compares performance against the visual policy.
